articles.summary: Dear Stakeholders, I wanted to make sure you had a chance to see the blog we posted last week highlighting recent U.S. policy initiatives that point to a clear shift in how the U.S. and its allies are approaching critical minerals.From U.S.Mexico coordination on phosphate, to Project Vault, to the new U.S.Cook Islands framework, the direction is consistent: more secure, transparent, and alliedaligned supply chains. As we note in the blog, Odysseys portfolio is already aligned with the regions, minerals, and science this policy architecture prioritizes. More updates soon as this momentum continues. Best regards, Mark Gordon CEO Chairman of the Board Odyssey Marine Exploration
